query_normalized: predicting molecular permeability coefficients using graph neural networks and publicly available datasets chemistry
rationale: This paper satisfies criterion (a) and (b) because it addresses the same biological mechanism (cell membrane permeability) by predicting lipophilicity coefficients (logP/logD), which are the primary determinants of molecular permeability, using a Graph Neural Network architecture (D-MPNN) on molecular data. Although it focuses on lipophilicity rather than the permeability coefficient directly, it provides the canonical prior work on the underlying physical property and the specific GNN methodolo
